# API Contract Quality Checklist: Transactions

**Purpose**: Validate that the transaction endpoint requirements and contract are complete, consistent with the other features, and unambiguous for the frontend
**Created**: 2026-09-16
**Feature**: [spec.md](../spec.md) · [contracts/transactions.openapi.yaml](../contracts/transactions.openapi.yaml) · [data-model.md](../data-model.md)

**Note**: This custom checklist is generated by the `/speckit-checklist` command based on feature context and requirements.
**Review Ownership**: This checklist is a reviewer-owned requirements-quality review artifact. Mark an item `[x]` only when the reviewer determines the requirements-quality criterion is satisfied.
**Marker Semantics**: `[x]` means the criterion has been reviewed and satisfied for requirements quality. It does not mean implementation work is complete.

## Requirement Completeness

- [ ] CHK001 Does every endpoint have request schema, success schema and every failure status listed? [Completeness, contracts]
- [ ] CHK002 Is the page envelope (`items`, `total`, `limit`, `offset`) fully specified, including `total` after filters? [Completeness, Spec §FR-006]
- [ ] CHK003 Is every field of the summary response defined with its derivation? [Completeness, Spec §FR-008, data-model.md]
- [ ] CHK004 Is the nested category shape on each row fixed (`id`, `name`, `type`) rather than left as "name and type"? [Completeness, Spec §FR-007]

## Requirement Clarity

- [ ] CHK005 Is the list ordering (`transaction_date` desc, then `id` desc) unambiguous for rows with identical timestamps? [Clarity, Spec §FR-004]
- [ ] CHK006 Is the ordering of `by_category` rows stated? [Clarity, Spec §FR-008]
- [ ] CHK007 Is the status code for a type/category mismatch fixed (422 with string detail) and distinguished from a not-found category (404)? [Clarity, research.md R7]
- [ ] CHK008 Are the exact error strings (`Transaction not found`, `Category not found`, mismatch, range, guard) fixed for the frontend? [Clarity, contracts]

## Requirement Consistency

- [ ] CHK009 Do money validation rules match profile and categories (reject > 2 decimals, ≥ 0 / > 0)? [Consistency, Spec §Clarifications Q1]
- [ ] CHK010 Does the `type` vocabulary match categories (`income`, `expense`)? [Consistency, specs/007-categories]
- [ ] CHK011 Does the budget period definition match categories Q4 and user-auth `budget_start_day` 1-28? [Consistency, Spec §FR-009]
- [ ] CHK012 Does the frontend transaction/history/dashboard spec set (PR #4: 001, 002, 004, 005) expect these shapes, especially the page envelope and `by_category` with `budget`? [Consistency, Gap]

## Acceptance Criteria Quality

- [ ] CHK013 Does every FR map to at least one row of the test matrix in quickstart.md? [Traceability]
- [ ] CHK014 Is "totals match listed rows to the cent" testable with a concrete dataset? [Measurability, Spec §SC-002]
- [ ] CHK015 Is the latency target stated with percentile, threshold and data volume? [Measurability, Spec §NFR-001]

## Scenario & Edge Case Coverage

- [ ] CHK016 Is the behaviour when only one of `from`/`to` is supplied specified? [Edge Case, Gap]
- [ ] CHK017 Is the behaviour for an empty PATCH body specified? [Edge Case, Gap]
- [ ] CHK018 Is `description` trimming and empty-string handling specified? [Edge Case, Gap]
- [ ] CHK019 Are requirements defined for a period with transactions exactly at the boundaries (00:00 on period start, 23:59:59 on period end)? [Edge Case, Spec §FR-009]

## Notes

- Mark items `[x]` only after review confirms the requirement-quality criterion is satisfied
- Leave items unchecked when they still require clarification, correction, or reviewer evaluation
- `/speckit-implement` reads checklist checkbox state as a gate and must not modify markers
- `checklists/requirements.md` has a separate built-in lifecycle maintained by `/speckit-specify` and `/speckit-clarify`
